Extract SVG statistics for selected genes

Source: R/svg_marker.R
extract_svg_stats.Rd

Extract SVG statistics for selected genes

Usage

extract_svg_stats(
  svg_norm,
  genes,
  stat = "LR_stat",
  gene_id = "rownames",
  method_order = NULL
)

Arguments

svg_norm

Named list of SVG results.

genes

Character vector of genes.

stat

SVG statistic column.

gene_id

Gene identifier.

method_order

Optional method order.

Value

Data frame. #' @examples # Create a small SpatialExperiment object counts <- matrix( 1:12, nrow = 3, dimnames = list( c("GeneA", "GeneB", "GeneC"), paste0("Cell", seq_len(4)) ) )

spe <- SpatialExperiment::SpatialExperiment( assays = list(counts = counts) )

SummarizedExperiment::rowData(spe)$LR_stat <- c( 2.5, 4.0, 1.2 )

# Compare SVG statistics across normalization methods svg_norm <- list( None = spe, scran = spe )

result <- extract_svg_stats( svg_norm = svg_norm, genes = c("GeneA", "GeneB") )

print(result)
